text: APPROVE. Both extractions preserve the original logic exactly: `ContinueQuote` still skips the next character on a backslash and clears the quote on the closing quote, and `IsShebang` is the same condition as before. Most of the nested branches left `CommentStart`, so its complexity is well under 15. The helpers are private and static, `ref i` on the `for` loop variable is legal, and I see no new warnings. I reviewed the diff only and did not build or run the tests.
